import pytest
from jinja2.nativetypes import NativeEnvironment


def test_issue_1701_block_loop_index_native_env():
    """
    This test reproduces the TypeError: sequence item 0: expected str instance, int found
    when using loop.index inside a block in NativeEnvironment.
    """
    env = NativeEnvironment()
    template = env.from_string(
        "{% block test %}{% for i in range(1) %}{{ loop.index }}{% endfor %}{% endblock %}{{ self.test() }}"
    )
    # The original bug caused a TypeError during rendering.
    # The fix should allow it to render correctly, producing the integer 1.
    assert template.render() == 1
